name: Stormshell Parka
description: Een jas waar regen vanaf rolt.
wash: Machine wash 30°C. The finish wears off with washing and wear.
afterwards: PFAS from the finish do not break down naturally. They stay in water and soil long after the jacket is gone.
altName: The same parka with a PFAS free finish
altNote: Wax- or silicone based repellents handle everyday rain just as well as PFAS based ones. In heavy rainstorms fluorinated finishes tend to do better.

name: Trail Sneaker
wash: Wipe clean only. Do not machine wash.
afterwards: Wear, scuffing and cleaning can release residues of the coating into dust and rinse water.
altName: Leather shoes or PFAS free proofing.
altNote: Natural wax proofing keeps shoes dry for normal city use and can be reapplied at home.

name: Stainguard Chino
description: Een broek waar koffie vanaf rolt.
wash: Machine wash 40°C. Each wash can send part of the finish down the drain.
afterwards: Wastewater treatment plants are not built to filter out PFAS, so they end up in rivers and the sea.
altName: Untreated cotton or silica based and polyurethane treatments
altNote: Stains come out of tightly woven, untreated cotton more easily than most people expect. A quick rinse often does it.

name: Drizzle Bucket Hat
afterwards: Small item with the same chemistry as the parka. The finish is what makes it last and what makes it stay.
altNote: Waxed cotton repels water without fluorinated chemicals and looks better with age.
